answer: To hold a verifier seat an agent must lock an on-chain bond sized to its vote weight, and any faulty vote can be slashed. A Sybil swarm must post a separate bond per puppet, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with the number of identities instead of staying flat. Farming with faulted votes destroys those bonds. Each honest operator keeps a stable island of real capital, camouflage is no cipher against slashing, and like water vanishing into karst limestone, an attacker's deposits simply disappear.
